tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: As per the assessment order passed by the faceless unit of the Income Tax Department, there is no change in income assessed as compared to income reported in income tax return filed for FY 2023-24 (AY 2024-25). However, the computation of income forming part of the Assessment Order for AY 2024-25 (FY 2023-24) contains errors, which have consequently resulted in an erroneous tax demand of Rs. 6,37,96,318/- (Rupees Six Crores Thirty Seven Lakhs Ninety Six Thousand Three Hundred and Eighteen Only) raised on the Company, inclusive of interest.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Deputy Commissioner of Income Tax, Circle 1, Pune
tax_litigation.status: The said Rectification Application has been accepted by the Assessing Officer. Accordingly, the error in computation forming part of the assessment order has been rectified and there is no change in the income assessed. Consequently, the demand of Rs. 6,37,96,318/- (Rupees Six Crores Thirty-Seven Lakhs Ninety-Six Thousand Three Hundred and Eighteen Only) raised earlier on account of such error stands addressed and the same has been reduced to NIL. The order dated 23rd April 2026 was received on 27th April 2026.

Mundra project opportunity placed on hold to reassess return profile and capital allocation timing.
Foreign exchange gain in FY26 was ₹138 Cr (₹74 Cr in Q4 FY26).
Soham Leisure Ventures reported FY26 turnover of ₹40.66 Cr, FY25 turnover of ₹46.19 Cr, and FY24 turnover of ₹45.08 Cr.
India occupancy 67% (up about 7%) and ADR up about 8% in Q1FY27, giving 20% RevPAR growth.
Annuity business committed occupancy 98% with 87% EBITDA margin on ₹128 Cr revenue.
Maldives fuel cost per litre doubled from pre-war levels in April-May; July fuel costs recovered 26% from the peak.

timeline.summary: Assessing Officer rectified computation error under Section 154, reducing ₹6.38 Cr tax demand to NIL with no change in assessed income.
Ventive Hospitality received requests from 11 promoter group entities holding 0 shares for re-classification to public category.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹778.77 Cr (+11.6% YoY), net profit ₹259.24 Cr.
Ventive Hospitality board approved a proposed agreement amendment to subscribe to ₹30 Cr OCDs of subsidiary Soham Leisure Ventures.
Ventive Hospitality presented its Q4 FY26 investor presentation detailing plans to scale portfolio to 4,000+ keys over 5 years.
Ventive Hospitality filed certified SEBI ICDR KPI disclosures for FY26 reporting RevPAR of ₹14,595 and Total Income of ₹2,666.09 Cr.
Ventive Hospitality Limited shared the audio recording link for its May 13, 2026, conference call on audited Q4FY26 and FY26 results via its website.
CRISIL confirmed Ventive Hospitality's ₹1,600 Cr IPO proceeds were fully utilized as of March 31, 2026, with no deviations.
Ventive Hospitality hosted its Q4 FY26 earnings call, guiding to low-teen revenue and high-teen EBITDA growth over the medium term with ₹1,000 Cr capex planned over 3 years.
Ventive Hospitality completed a ₹50 Cr investment into 76%-owned subsidiary Soham Leisure Ventures via 50 lakh OCDs at par.
Conference call for unaudited financial results (quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026) revised to 3:30 PM IST on Tuesday, November 3, 2026.
